properties.description: Both changes came from the design misleading the agent maintaining it, which is the failure reflow2 exists to prevent. Closure had two available answers — an INVALIDATES edge for the gap detector, valid_to for the age computation — so a finding another record had refuted was closed for one surface and current for the other. ClaimAge gains superseded_by, filled by DesignGraph::claim_age_of, one graph-aware computation that search_design and topic_report both use, kept distinct from expired because a claim that ran out is not a claim something overturned. And the unreachable-vocabulary baseline is split by intent rather than counted flat: 14 holes, 15 written by an operation, 13 unused, each with a reason a reader can disagree with, so the number can be read as a to-do list instead of overstating the work by two thirds.
properties.name: v0.53.0 — a refuted finding stops reading as current, and a count starts meaning something
